testCases.title: Rooms page loads successfully after login
preconditions: User is logged in with Employee role
testCases.expectedResult: Rooms listing page renders with header, filters, and room cards displayed correctly

testCases.title: Room cards display correct details and status
preconditions: User is logged in with Employee role
At least one room exists in the system
steps: Verify room number, type (AC/Non-AC), location (Chalikkavattom/Vyttila), and status are shown
testCases.expectedResult: All room cards display accurate room number, AC/Non-AC type, location, and current status (Vacant/Occupied/Maintenance)

testCases.title: Filter rooms by location successfully
preconditions: User is logged in with Employee role
Rooms exist in both Chalikkavattom and Vyttila locations
steps: Select Chalikkavattom from location filter dropdown
testCases.expectedResult: Only rooms located in Chalikkavattom are displayed; Vyttila rooms are hidden

testCases.title: Undo Checkout action works for recently checked out room
preconditions: User is logged in with Employee role
A room has been checked out recently (within undo window)
steps: Locate a room with Occupied status that was recently checked out
Click Undo Checkout button on that room card
testCases.expectedResult: Room status reverts to Vacant, checkout record is removed, and success notification is displayed

testCases.title: Empty state displays when no rooms match filter criteria
preconditions: User is logged in with Employee role
steps: Apply a filter combination that returns zero results (e.g., location = Chalikkavattom AND status = Maintenance when no such rooms exist)
testCases.expectedResult: Empty state message is displayed indicating no rooms match the selected criteria, with option to clear filters

testCases.title: Multiple rooms with Maintenance status are handled correctly
preconditions: User is logged in with Employee role
At least two rooms are set to Maintenance status simultaneously
steps: Verify all maintenance rooms are displayed
Check that Maintenance status is visually distinct from Vacant and Occupied
testCases.expectedResult: All rooms with Maintenance status are displayed, each showing correct maintenance status indicator, and no Occupied/Vacant rooms appear in the filtered results
